Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick note at SDS. We'd like to schedule a 45-minute demo for the payments+compliance flow next month. Our core stakeholders are in Tokyo (APAC), London (EU) and a couple people in SF (US).

Quick constraints on our side: Golden Week runs into early May here in Japan and several product folks will be OOO from May 2–5; Ravi in India indicated he has a travel block around late April (internal training), and there is a US DST transition around that same week which sometimes causes confusion with calendar invites.

Would you have availability for any of these windows (we can confirm exact slots after you propose):
- May 3–4 (APAC morning / US late evening)
- May 10–12 (more flexible)
- Mid-May (May 17–21) — best for our product team

If it's helpful, Ken Saito (cc'd here: ken.saito@kizuna-pay.jp) can cover the demo if our head of product is OOO. We also prefer a live demo vs. prerecorded; if attendance can't be guaranteed, a recording is appreciated.

Thanks,
Akiko

Hi Akiko — great to connect and thanks for the context.

We can absolutely accommodate a cross-region demo. Proposed approach: pick one primary slot that works for as many stakeholders as possible, and a recorded version + a follow-up deep-dive for those who can't attend. To make scheduling less error-prone I'm proposing three concrete timeboxes (with explicit UTC offsets):

Option A — APAC-friendly (works for Tokyo morning):
- May 3, 09:00–09:45 JST / May 2, 17:00–17:45 PDT / May 2, 01:00–01:45 UTC

Option B — EU-friendly (London overlap):
- May 18, 15:00–15:45 BST / May 18, 07:00–07:45 PDT / May 18, 23:00–23:45 JST

Option C — US-friendly (SF daytime):
- May 19, 09:00–09:45 PDT / May 19, 17:00–17:45 BST / May 20, 01:00–01:45 JST

Notes:
- Option A hits the Golden Week window — I flagged this because you mentioned May 2–5 has some OOO. If several Tokyo stakeholders are out, Option B or C might be better.
- I included UTC offsets explicitly to avoid DST confusion.
- We'll record and share; agenda attached (demo-agenda-pilot.pdf).

If you can confirm which option looks closest for the core attendees (or if Ken can run Option A), we will lock the calendar invite and add a recording option + follow-up 30-minute office hours for deeper integrations.

Best,
Marcus
